description: FNPF theta-Robin time integration A 310 5 (theta A 300 0.5, Robin row at the free surface, Eigen SparseLU, prototype 2D serial), standing wave of fnpf_2d_standing_a301 at 10 steps per period (beyond the RK3 limit of the grid cut-off mode, omega_max dt 2.3), nonlinear FSBC A 314 2 with the Adams-Bashforth 2 terms.
